newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-H&M 6 mo profit seen 35 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-H&M 6 mo profit seen 35 pct up.

text.p: Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz (H&M) was expected to post a 35 percent rise in profit after financial items of 832 million crowns for the first six months of 1996/97, a Reuters poll found on Wednesday.
This compared to a profit after financial items of 618 million crowns for the same period a year ago that runs from December 1 to May 30.
Estimates from nine analysts varied between 618 and 950 million crowns.
H&M's profit after financial items was forecast to rise to 2.38 billion crowns for the full year 1996/97 compared to 1.91 billion crowns a year earlier.
Analysts saw the profit rising further to 2.82 billion crowns in 1997/98.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Penser, Fiba, Goldman Sachs, Handelsbanken, James Capel, SBC Warburg, and Swedbank.
H&M will release its half year report on June 16.
